name: Runner Tests Fixture - Coverage Dependency Source Subject
brief: #3965: a sibling SOURCE dependency whose executed statement must appear in the Cobertura report without the app becoming an execution bundle.
description: AlRunner#3965: AlCoverageSourceMap.Build is fed only the execution bundles, so a statement executed in a dependency compiled from sibling source cannot be attributed and is dropped from the report. This app exists only to own one executed statement and one NEVER-executed statement, so a fix that attributes everything indiscriminately is as visible as one that attributes nothing.
